name: Request a studio audit

title: "Audit request: "
---

## Game and baseline

- Game repository / accessible project:
- Commit / branch / build identity:
- Unity version and renderer, if known:
- Target platforms, input methods, and release stage:
- Genre, audience, and intended experience:

## Requested review

- Main concerns and known problems:
- Disciplines or flows to focus on:
- Requirements or design references:
- Scope exclusions:

## Available evidence

List accessible source, screenshots, video, audio, logs, tests, builds, or profiler captures. Do not post credentials, private source, proprietary captures, or personal data to this public issue.

## Runtime scope and report destination

The default is source and supplied-evidence review. Specify any already-authorized isolated runtime checks, test saves/services, and target devices. Audit output must be outside the original game project. Specify which sanitized results, if any, may be published.

## Expected result

An evidence-backed report, prioritized findings, coverage limits, and future fix/investigation prompts. The original game's code, scenes, prefabs, assets, packages, settings, and player data remain unchanged. Implementation is a separate task.
